Question 17 / 18
What is the primary purpose of SGDRegressor in sklearn?
To perform regression tasks using stochastic gradient descent


What does setting random_state in train_test_split() ensure?
The split is reproducible each time the code is run


What is the purpose of the fit() function in sklearn?
To train the model on the provided dataset

What can happen if the learning rate in gradient descent is set too high?

The gradient descent may fail to converge and oscillate around the minimum


Which of the following is a common cost function used in linear regression with gradient descent?
Mean Squared Error (MSE)

n gradient descent, what does the gradient represent?
The direction and rate of the steepest ascent

fit_intercept

Which statement is true for sklearn.linear_model.LinearRegression?
It minimizes the mean squared error using the closed-form solution


What can happen if the learning rate is set too high in gradient descent?
The gradient descent may diverge or oscillate

In gradient descent, what does the learning rate control?
The magnitude of the steps taken towards the minimum
